item.title: Vapour CLI and Profiler
item.description:
Tooling for Vapour, a platform for web games.

  • vapour-cli (Go, MIT). Logs in, creates a game project, and builds and publishes web exports for Godot, Unity and Bevy. It scans and signs build zips, does chunked and delta uploads, and runs games locally with an FPS overlay (vapour test).
  • vapour-profiler (Rust, eBPF). A standalone, local-first eBPF profiler for Wasm runtimes and Linux processes. It uses CO-RE BPF attach/detach, and capture is explicit and bounded. It ships a local performance dashboard and per-asset load observability.

item.title: Kukri
item.description:
A Linux network ACL/firewall. eBPF programs run on XDP ingress and TC egress, and a Rust control plane (libbpf-rs) drives them. A ratatui terminal UI edits rules live.

MAC, IPv4/CIDR and TCP/UDP port filters are chained with BPF prog-array tail calls. Each rule category toggles at runtime, with zero overhead when disabled. The userspace–kernel map-sync layer uses LPM tries and array/hash maps, with a JSON-schema-validated config.

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/kukri

item.title: ARP Stack
item.description:
ARP implemented from scratch over raw AF_PACKET sockets in promiscuous mode, with no networking libraries. It covers Ethernet frame parsing and construction, ARP request/reply handling, MAC resolution, the ARP cache, and packet transmission.

Write-up: Writing ARP From Scratch and My Learnings

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/arp-from-scratch

item.title: TCP Chat Server
item.description:
A multi-client TCP chat server in Rust. It handles concurrent connections, broadcasts messages, and keeps per-client state, with colored terminal output. Connect with nc 127.0.0.1 5000.

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/chat-server

item.title: KiloDB
item.description:
A Redis-compatible key-value server on Rust TCP sockets. It parses the RESP wire protocol and serves concurrent clients. It supports Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets, TTL and key management commands.

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/KiloDB

item.title: E-Commerce API
item.description:
A RESTful API for small e-commerce businesses, built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB (Mongoose). 20 stars, 10 forks.

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/E-Commerce-API

item.title: PyTorch U-Net Segmentation
item.description:
U-Net semantic segmentation in PyTorch. It has a custom N-class one-hot encoder and supports aerial image datasets. 12 stars, 4 forks.

Source: github.com/madhavkhoslaa/Pytorch-U-Net-Segmentation
